notes: R38 addresses a critical consistency issue around item identifiers that have diverged between formal specification terminology and warehouse operational usage. PRIMARY evidence (E1–E9) consistently documents that warehouse staff use informal terminology (barcode, serial code) while the specification uses formal wording, creating ambiguity in UI labels, backend storage, reporting, and notifications. E5 and E6 (REFINES and AFFECTS) indicate implementation is proceeding without clarity on whether these are aliases or separate fields. E4 and E8 show reporting and notification systems are also affected. E9 references a related gap on identifier format conflict. CONTEXT evidence (E10, E13, E14, E15) reinforces that identifier consistency issues extend to reporting and historical data. The operative context captures the core requirement that consistency must be maintained across all layers; exceptions acknowledge that operational aliases are acceptable if the formal identifier remains stable; conflicts document the unresolved divergence between specification and implementation; gaps list the critical open questions that must be resolved before consistent behavior can be enforced."
